[LNUL.9.1] **Representation: `null` is a `kind`, not a box.** It is one more
discriminant on the existing tagged slot value (`kind` + `v` union) —
**zero extra bytes per slot**, no heap, no `Option` indirection. This is what
makes `T?` viable on a 264 KB-RAM-class target (RP2350) and is the concrete
meaning of "flow-typed, not boxed" ([LNUL.3.2]). **The kind-tag must not be
"optimised" into a wrapper or a box.**
